title: EyeCare — assisted eye screening
description: Screen for uncorrected refractive error, the largest single cause of visual impairment, in under ten minutes using an ordinary webcam. Literacy-free Tumbling E chart, camp mode for health workers, and a report written to be handed to a clinician.
